definition: Sudden and unexpected, often in a way that feels rough.
example: The bus came to an abrupt stop, and our bags slid across the floor.

options.text: Smooth and carefully planned
Gradual and hardly noticed
Sudden and without warning
Long and drawn out over time

explanation: Abrupt means sudden and without warning. Great job!

definition: To gather or pile up gradually over time.
example: Snow began to accumulate on the roof during the night.

options.text: To pile up little by little
To melt away little by little
To spread out over a wide area
To throw away in a hurry

explanation: To accumulate is to pile up little by little. Nice work!

definition: To speak or write in support of an idea or a plan.
example: Our class decided to advocate for a longer lunch break.

options.text: To argue against an idea in public
To vote on an idea in secret
To speak up in support of an idea
To keep quiet about an idea on purpose

explanation: To advocate is to speak up in support of an idea. Well done!

definition: More than enough; plenty.
example: We brought ample water for the whole hike, so nobody went thirsty.

options.text: Just barely enough for a need
Too little for a need
More than enough for a need
Hard to find when it is needed

explanation: Ample means more than enough for a need. You got it!

definition: A short, interesting story about something that really happened to someone.
example: My grandfather told an anecdote about his first day at a new school.

options.text: A long book full of made-up tales
A poem that has a steady rhythm
A list of facts about a subject
A short story about a real event

explanation: An anecdote is a short story about a real event. Great job!

definition: Real and genuine, not a copy or a fake.
example: The museum has an authentic coin that is over a thousand years old.

options.text: Made to look like the real thing
Very old and worth a lot of money
Real and genuine, not a fake
Rare and found in only one place

explanation: Authentic means real and genuine. Nice work!

definition: A condition or fact that surrounds an event and affects it.
example: A sudden storm was the circumstance that forced the school to hold the picnic indoors.

options.text: A path that goes around something
The final result of an event
A condition that surrounds an event
A rule that guides an event

explanation: A circumstance is a condition that surrounds an event. Well done!

definition: Clear and logical, with ideas that fit together well.

options.text: Messy and jumping between topics
Short and written in a hurry
Full of long and unusual words
Clear and logical, with ideas that fit

explanation: Coherent means clear and logical, with ideas that fit together. You got it!

definition: To work together with others to make or do something.

options.text: To compete against others for a prize
To work together on one project
To work alone on a hard task
To give orders to a group

explanation: To collaborate is to work together on one project. Great job!

definition: Able to work or exist well together.

options.text: Built to fit only one thing
Likely to wear out quickly
Easy to carry from place to place
Able to work well together

explanation: Compatible means able to work well together. Nice work!

definition: Following the usual way or habit of a group.

options.text: Rare and seen only once a year
Made just for one person
Strange and hard to predict
Usual and expected as a habit

explanation: Customary means usual and expected as a habit. Well done!

definition: To prepare soil and grow plants, or to work at developing something.

options.text: To pick flowers for a vase
To prepare soil and grow plants
To build a tall fence around a field
To store seeds in a dry place

explanation: To cultivate is to prepare soil and grow plants. You got it!

options.text: Done by accident in a hurry
Done only when no one is looking
Done for fun with no plan
Done on purpose after careful thought

explanation: Deliberate means done on purpose after careful thought. Great job!

definition: To be the strongest, biggest or most noticeable part of something.
example: The tall mountain seems to dominate the view from our window.

options.text: To blend in with the background
To stand just behind others
To be one of many equal parts
To be the strongest or biggest part

explanation: To dominate is to be the strongest or biggest part. Nice work!

definition: Able to speak or write in a clear, powerful and graceful way.

Able to speak only in short words
Able to speak in a very loud voice
Able to remember a speech by heart

explanation: Eloquent means able to speak in a clear, graceful way. Well done!

definition: To pull or take something out, often from inside something else.

options.text: To pack something tightly inside a big box
To pull something out of another thing
To pour a liquid over a surface
To tie two things firmly together

explanation: To extract is to pull something out of another thing. You got it!

definition: To grow strongly and be healthy and successful.

To grow only in the dark
To grow strongly and do well
To stay small for a long time

definition: Forming the basic or most important base of something.

Basic and necessary as a starting point
Hard and understood by few people
New and different from all others

explanation: Fundamental means basic and necessary as a starting point. Nice work!

definition: To light up a place or to make something clear.

To hide a place in shadow
To paint the walls of a place
To warm the air in a place

explanation: To illuminate is to fill a place with light. Well done!

definition: A sudden urge to do something without thinking it through.

options.text: A careful plan made over many days
A sudden urge to act without thinking
A reason that someone gives for acting
A quiet habit that never changes

explanation: An impulse is a sudden urge to act without thinking. You got it!

definition: Certain to happen and impossible to avoid.

options.text: Certain to happen, with no way around it
Possible but very unlikely to happen
Easy to stop if you start early
Hoped for by almost everyone

explanation: Inevitable means certain to happen, with no way around it. Great job!

definition: A clear and deep understanding of something.

options.text: A deep and clear understanding
A quick look at something
A guess made without knowing any facts
A view from a high place

explanation: An insight is a deep and clear understanding. Nice work!

definition: To combine parts so that they work together as a whole.

options.text: To divide a whole into parts
To arrange parts in a straight line
To count the parts of a whole
To combine parts into one whole

explanation: To integrate is to combine parts into one whole. Well done!

definition: Having many small parts or details that fit together in a complicated way.

options.text: Plain and made of only one simple shape
Very large and easy to see
Smooth and finished in one color
Full of small, complicated details

explanation: Intricate means full of small, complicated details. You got it!

definition: Clear enough to be read easily.

options.text: Clear enough to read easily
Allowed by the rules of a game
Printed in very small letters
Written in a language you do not know

explanation: Legible means clear enough to read easily. Great job!

definition: Following the exact meaning of the words, without any hidden or figurative sense.

options.text: Related to books and stories
Based on the exact meaning of the words
Written in an old-fashioned style
Meant to surprise the reader

explanation: Literal means based on the exact meaning of the words. Nice work!

definition: To make something stronger by adding support.

To make something stronger with support
To move something to a new place
To measure how strong something is

explanation: To reinforce is to make something stronger with support. Well done!

definition: Dull because it stays the same and never changes.

options.text: Dull because it never changes
Lively because it keeps changing
Peaceful and filled with soft sounds
Difficult because it has many steps

explanation: Monotonous means dull because it never changes. You got it!

options.text: To give way under strong force
To hold up against strong force
To stand in line for a long time
To carry a load over a long way

explanation: To withstand is to hold up against strong force. Great job!

definition: An idea or belief about something.

A fact that has been proven
An idea or belief about something
A movement made with the hand or arm

explanation: A notion is an idea or belief about something. Nice work!

definition: No longer used because something newer has taken its place.

options.text: Out of date and no longer in use
Used more now than ever before
Too costly for most families to buy today
Broken and waiting to be repaired

explanation: Obsolete means no longer used because it is outdated. Well done!

definition: Expecting good things to happen; hopeful about the future.

options.text: Expecting the worst to happen
Expecting nothing to change at all
Expecting good things to happen
Expecting a plan to take longer

explanation: Optimistic means expecting good things to happen. You got it!

definition: To begin or come into being from a certain source.

options.text: To begin from a certain source
To end at a certain place
To flow back toward its start
To change from one form to another

explanation: To originate is to begin from a certain source. Great job!

definition: Not complete; being only a part of the whole.

Only a part, not the whole
Divided into two equal parts
Repeated again and again

explanation: Partial means only a part, not the whole. Nice work!

definition: Strange or unusual in a way that is hard to explain.

options.text: Normal and just what you expect
Private and meant for only one person to see
Strange and different from the usual
Popular with a lot of people

explanation: Peculiar means strange and different from the usual. Well done!

definition: The ability to grow or become something in the future.
example: The coach saw great potential in the new player.

options.text: A reward for finishing a task
A promise you make to others
A list of all the skills you have learned
The ability to become something later

explanation: Potential is the ability to become something later. You got it!

definition: To keep something safe and in good condition.
example: Museums work hard to preserve old paintings so people can enjoy them for years.

options.text: To keep something safe and in good shape
To change something into a new form
To serve something to a large group
To sell something to a collector

explanation: To preserve is to keep something safe and in good shape. Great job!

definition: To win or succeed in the end.

options.text: To win or succeed in the end
To fail at the very last moment
To tie after extra time
To begin a game before others

explanation: To prevail is to win or succeed in the end. Nice work!

definition: Very deep or serious, in thought or feeling.

Very light and easy to forget
Very deep in thought or feeling
Very simple and easy to explain

explanation: Profound means very deep in thought or feeling. Well done!

definition: Easy to see or well known because it stands out.

options.text: Hidden because it blends in
Placed far away from everything
Plain and found in many different places
Easy to notice because it stands out

explanation: Prominent means easy to notice because it stands out. You got it!

definition: Stiff and not able to bend.

options.text: Soft and easy to bend
Stiff and unable to bend
Thin and able to stretch
Smooth and slippery to touch

explanation: Rigid means stiff and unable to bend. Great job!

definition: Not easily convinced; doubting that something is true until you see proof.

Doubting something until there is proof
Repeating something you heard
Hoping something will come true

explanation: Skeptical means doubting something until there is proof. Nice work!

definition: Done naturally and suddenly, without planning.
example: The spontaneous picnic began when it turned out to be a lovely afternoon.

options.text: Done suddenly without planning
Planned carefully for weeks
Practiced many times before
Done only when someone tells you to

explanation: Spontaneous means done suddenly without planning. Well done!

definition: Not obvious; so slight or delicate that it is hard to notice.
example: There is a subtle difference between the two shades of blue.

options.text: Bold and easy to spot
Slight and hard to notice
Complete and without any gaps
Sour and sharp in taste

explanation: Subtle means slight and hard to notice. You got it!

definition: Something added to make a thing complete or better.

options.text: Something added to complete a thing
Something taken away from the whole thing
A copy kept in case of loss
A test given at the end of a unit

explanation: A supplement is something added to complete a thing. Great job!

definition: Able to be touched; real and solid.

options.text: Able to be heard from far off
Able to be changed with ease
Able to be seen only at night
Able to be touched and felt

explanation: Tangible means able to be touched and felt. Nice work!

Done in a hurry with no thought
Planned for now but open to change
Agreed on by all and ready to begin

definition: A change from one condition, stage or place to another.

options.text: A short break between two classes
A final test at the end of a year
A trip made between two towns
A change from one stage to another

explanation: A transition is a change from one stage to another. You got it!

definition: Of little importance or value.

options.text: Serious and worth careful thought
Small and not worth much concern
Tricky and full of surprises
Familiar and loved by many

explanation: Trivial means small and not worth much concern. Great job!

definition: Next to or very near something.
example: The library is adjacent to the school gym, so we can walk there in a minute.

options.text: Far across from something else
Placed high above something else
Right next to something else
Turned away from something else

explanation: Adjacent means right next to something else. Nice work!
